title: Hobie Sailboats & Sailing Gear
seo_title: Hobie Sailboats & Parts | Quest Watersports, Ottawa IL
seo_description: Shop Hobie Cat sailboats, Mirage Island trimarans and sailing parts at Quest Watersports in Ottawa, IL, on the Illinois River in Starved Rock Country.
body_html:
There is something magical about being on the water. Quest Watersports is your Hobie sailing dealer in Ottawa, Illinois, with Hobie Cat catamarans, Hobie Mirage Island sailing kayaks, and the parts and rigging help to keep them sailing.

Hobie sailboats at Quest

We stock and special-order the Hobie sailing line, including:

  • Hobie Wave: an easy-to-sail, easy-to-rig 13-foot catamaran that is fun for the family and exciting for juniors.
  • Hobie Getaway: a 17-foot family cruiser, available with or without wings.
  • Hobie 16: the classic 16-foot racing and beach catamaran, in Mistral or Zephyr colors.
  • Hobie Mirage Tandem Island: an 18-foot pedal-and-sail trimaran for one or two.

Availability changes with the season and Hobie's production, so call 815.433.2200 to check what is in stock or to be placed on a waiting list for a new boat or special order.

Shop sailboats · Shop sailing parts and accessories

Sailing parts and accessories

Pins, clevis rings, rudder parts, hydrofoils, tillers, tools and spare-parts kits for Hobie Wave, Getaway, Hobie 14 and 16 are available in the store. Browse the sailing parts collection, or call us with your boat's model and we will help track down the right part.

Rigging and how-to help

Need help getting set up? We can help. Reach out and let's get your boat outfitted for your ideal use. Call 815-433-2200 or email us.

Own a Hobie Island? Join the club

Sail with fellow Hobie Adventure Island and Tandem Island owners in our local club. See Inland Islanders.

Visit us

Quest Watersports, 1851 N 2871st Road, Ottawa, IL 61350, next to Heritage Harbor Ottawa marina. Sales are open Tuesday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM; Sunday and Monday by appointment. See hours and directions.
